"""Native-frame astrometry and conditioned GLS motion fits (impl. §4.7).

Offsets and parallax are arcseconds; time is Julian years. No image resampling.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from astropy.coordinates import get_body_barycentric
from astropy.time import Time

AU_KM = 149597870.7


def visit_centroid(points: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """GLS constant visit position; retain xy covariance and excess scatter.

    This does not estimate inter-frame correlated systematics or model the
    source's within-visit motion. The contributing epochs remain explicit.
    """
    if not points:
        raise ValueError("visit has no native positions")
    values = np.array([[p["xi"], p["eta"]] for p in points], float)
    covariances = np.array(
        [[[p["s_xi"] ** 2, p.get("cov_xi_eta", 0)], [p.get("cov_xi_eta", 0), p["s_eta"] ** 2]] for p in points]
    )
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(covariances)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(values)):
        raise ValueError("finite visit positions/covariance required")
    for covariance in covariances:
        np.linalg.cholesky(covariance)
    precision = np.linalg.inv(covariances)
    covariance = np.linalg.inv(precision.sum(axis=0))
    mean = covariance @ np.einsum("nij,nj->i", precision, values)
    residual = values - mean
    chi2 = float(np.einsum("ni,nij,nj", residual, precision, residual))
    dof = 2 * len(points) - 2
    if dof:
        covariance *= max(1.0, chi2 / dof)
    return dict(
        mean=mean,
        covariance=covariance,
        chi2=chi2,
        dof=dof,
        n=len(points),
        mjd=float(np.mean([p["mjd"] for p in points])),
    )


def sky_covariance(wcs: Any, x: float, y: float, covariance_px: Any) -> Any:
    """Local WCS Jacobian into (RA*cosDec,Dec), including detector rotation and SIP."""
    import astropy.units as u
    from astropy.coordinates import SkyCoord

    ra, dec = wcs.pixel_to_world_values(x, y)
    origin = SkyCoord(ra * u.deg, dec * u.deg)
    jac = np.empty((2, 2))
    for col, (dx, dy) in enumerate(((1e-3, 0), (0, 1e-3))):
        a, d = wcs.pixel_to_world_values(x + dx, y + dy)
        da, dd = origin.spherical_offsets_to(SkyCoord(a * u.deg, d * u.deg))
        jac[:, col] = [da.arcsec / 1e-3, dd.arcsec / 1e-3]
    return jac @ np.asarray(covariance_px) @ jac.T


def isolated(ra: Any, dec: Any, min_sep_arcsec: float = 18.0) -> Any:
    """Nearest other catalogue member, vectorized; no quadratic SkyCoord loop."""
    import astropy.units as u
    from astropy.coordinates import SkyCoord

    if len(ra) < 2:
        return np.ones(len(ra), bool)
    coords = SkyCoord(np.asarray(ra) * u.deg, np.asarray(dec) * u.deg)
    _, sep, _ = coords.match_to_catalog_sky(coords, nthneighbor=2)
    return sep.arcsec >= min_sep_arcsec


def parallax_factors(mjd: Any, ra_deg: Any, dec_deg: Any, sc_geo_km: Any = None) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
    """ICRS observer barycentric position; spacecraft offsets must be ICRS km.

    An unverified header coordinate frame must never be passed as sc_geo_km.
    Earth-only factors are adequate for stellar parallax, not nearby SSO work.
    """
    xyz = get_body_barycentric("earth", Time(mjd, format="mjd", scale="utc")).xyz.to_value("au")
    if sc_geo_km is not None:
        sc = np.asarray(sc_geo_km, float)
        if sc.shape[0] != 3 or not np.all(np.isfinite(sc)):
            raise ValueError("observer position must be finite (3, ...) ICRS kilometres")
        xyz = xyz + sc / AU_KM
    x, y, z = xyz
    a, d = np.radians(ra_deg), np.radians(dec_deg)
    return (x * np.sin(a) - y * np.cos(a), x * np.cos(a) * np.sin(d) + y * np.sin(a) * np.sin(d) - z * np.cos(d))


def gls(design: Any, values: Any, covariance: Any, allow_exact: bool = False) -> tuple[Any, Any, float, int]:
    """Whiten then SVD; reject deficient designs instead of returning false precision."""
    a, b, c = np.asarray(design, float), np.asarray(values, float), np.asarray(covariance, float)
    if (
        not all(np.all(np.isfinite(v)) for v in (a, b, c))
        or len(b) < a.shape[1]
        or (len(b) == a.shape[1] and not allow_exact)
    ):
        raise ValueError("finite data and positive residual degrees of freedom required")
    chol = np.linalg.cholesky(c)
    aw, bw = np.linalg.solve(chol, a), np.linalg.solve(chol, b)
    scale = np.linalg.norm(aw, axis=0)
    if np.any(scale == 0):
        raise ValueError("unconstrained parameter")
    u, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(aw / scale, full_matrices=False)
    if s[-1] <= s[0] * 1e-10:
        raise ValueError("rank deficient or ill-conditioned motion geometry")
    p = (vt.T @ ((u.T @ bw) / s)) / scale
    cov = ((vt.T / s**2) @ vt) / np.outer(scale, scale)
    chi2 = float(np.sum((aw @ p - bw) ** 2))
    dof = len(b) - len(p)
    return p, cov * (max(1.0, chi2 / dof) if dof else 1.0), chi2, dof


def motion_fit(
    t_yr: Any,
    xi: Any,
    eta: Any,
    s_xi: Any,
    s_eta: Any,
    p_a: Any,
    p_d: Any,
    t0: float,
    plx_fixed: float | None = None,
    visit_ids: Any = None,
    visit_floor: float = 0.0,
    xy_covariance: Any = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Visit-shared error enters covariance blocks, so repeated frames cannot erase it."""
    t, x, y, sx, sy, pa, pd = [np.asarray(v, float) for v in (t_yr, xi, eta, s_xi, s_eta, p_a, p_d)]
    if len({v.shape for v in (t, x, y, sx, sy, pa, pd)}) != 1 or t.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("motion arrays must have equal one-dimensional shape")
    if np.any(sx <= 0) or np.any(sy <= 0) or visit_floor < 0:
        raise ValueError("positive errors required")
    n = len(t)
    a = np.zeros((2 * n, 5))
    a[:n, 0], a[n:, 1], a[:n, 2], a[n:, 3], a[:n, 4], a[n:, 4] = 1, 1, t - t0, t - t0, pa, pd
    b = np.r_[x, y]
    if plx_fixed is not None:
        b = b - a[:, 4] * plx_fixed
        a = a[:, :4]
    c = np.diag(np.r_[sx * sx, sy * sy])
    if xy_covariance is not None:
        xy = np.asarray(xy_covariance, float)
        if xy.shape != (n,) or not np.all(np.isfinite(xy)) or np.any(abs(xy) >= sx * sy):
            raise ValueError("finite positive-definite per-point sky covariance required")
        c[np.arange(n), n + np.arange(n)] = xy
        c[n + np.arange(n), np.arange(n)] = xy
    if visit_ids is not None:
        ids = np.asarray(visit_ids)
        shared = (ids[:, None] == ids[None, :]) * visit_floor**2
        c[:n, :n] += shared
        c[n:, n:] += shared
    # Two full WISE epochs constrain four linear parameters with externally
    # estimated measurement covariance, but leave zero model-test degrees of
    # freedom. Do not divide by zero or claim an estimated residual variance.
    p, cov, chi, dof = gls(a, b, c, allow_exact=plx_fixed is not None and n == 2)
    stationary = a[:, [0, 1] + ([4] if plx_fixed is None else [])]
    _, _, chi0, _ = gls(stationary, b, c)
    return dict(
        params=p,
        covariance=cov,
        errors=np.sqrt(np.diag(cov)),
        chi2=chi,
        dof=dof,
        delta_chi2=max(0.0, chi0 - chi),
        t0=t0,
        plx_fixed=plx_fixed,
    )


def fit_pm(
    t_yr: Any, xi: Any, eta: Any, s_xi: Any, s_eta: Any, p_a: Any, p_d: Any, t0: float, plx_fixed: float | None = None
) -> tuple[Any, Any, float]:
    r = motion_fit(t_yr, xi, eta, s_xi, s_eta, p_a, p_d, t0, plx_fixed)
    return r["params"], r["errors"], r["chi2"]


def registration(residuals_arcsec: Any, errors_arcsec: Any, min_stars: int = 5) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Robust translation from isolated Gaia stars; uncertainty includes their scatter."""
    r, e = np.asarray(residuals_arcsec, float), np.asarray(errors_arcsec, float)
    ok = np.all(np.isfinite(r) & np.isfinite(e) & (e > 0), axis=1)
    for _ in range(3):
        if ok.sum() < min_stars:
            raise ValueError("registration needs at least five isolated unsaturated Gaia stars")
        med = np.median(r[ok], axis=0)
        sig = np.maximum(1.4826 * np.median(abs(r[ok] - med), axis=0), np.median(e[ok], axis=0))
        ok &= np.all(abs(r - med) <= 4 * sig, axis=1)
    return dict(
        offset=med,
        error=1.2533 * sig / np.sqrt(ok.sum()),
        used=ok,
        before_rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(r[ok] ** 2, axis=0)),
        after_rms=np.sqrt(np.mean((r[ok] - med) ** 2, axis=0)),
    )

backend/spherex/epsf.py.source:
"""QR3 table ePSFs on zero-based parent pixels; native-pixel fits (impl. §4.7).

Table orientation is preserved. F5 must validate it against stars before release.
The finite table supports ±3.2 px, and must not be extrapolated into far wings.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

from .types import Grid


class EPSF:
    def __init__(self, table: Any, oversample: int = 5) -> None:
        self.xc, self.yc = np.asarray(table["XCENTER"], float), np.asarray(table["YCENTER"], float)
        psf = np.asarray(table["EPSF"], float)
        if psf.ndim != 3 or psf.shape[1] != psf.shape[2] or not np.all(np.isfinite(psf)):
            raise ValueError("EPSF must contain finite square zone arrays")
        sums = psf.sum(axis=(1, 2), keepdims=True)
        if np.any(sums <= 0) or oversample <= 0:
            raise ValueError("invalid EPSF integral or oversampling")
        self.os = oversample
        self.psf = psf / sums * self.os**2
        self.c = (psf.shape[-1] - 1) / 2

    def zone(self, xp: float, yp: float) -> int:
        if not (np.isfinite(xp) and np.isfinite(yp) and 0 <= xp < 2040 and 0 <= yp < 2040):
            raise ValueError("ePSF zone requires parent-detector pixels in [0,2040)")
        return int(np.argmin((self.xc - xp) ** 2 + (self.yc - yp) ** 2))

    def sample(self, iz: int, dx: Any, dy: Any) -> Any:
        return map_coordinates(
            self.psf[iz],
            [self.c + self.os * np.asarray(dy), self.c + self.os * np.asarray(dx)],
            order=3,
            mode="grid-constant",
            cval=0.0,
        )

    def stamp(self, iz: int, dx: float, dy: float, half: int = 3) -> Any:
        yy, xx = np.mgrid[-half : half + 1, -half : half + 1]
        return self.sample(iz, xx - dx, yy - dy)


@dataclass
class StarFit:
    params: Any
    covariance: Any
    rchi2: float
    dof: int
    wing_fit: bool
    model: Any

    @property
    def errors(self) -> Any:
        return np.sqrt(np.diag(self.covariance))


def fit_native(
    img: Any,
    var: Any,
    bad: Any,
    epsf: EPSF,
    iz: int,
    x0: float,
    y0: float,
    half: int = 3,
    fixed_xy: bool = False,
    max_shift: float = 1.5,
    background_order: int = 0,
) -> StarFit | None:
    if background_order not in (0, 1):
        raise ValueError("background order must be constant or plane")
    ix, iy = int(round(x0)), int(round(y0))
    ny, nx = img.shape
    if ix - half < 0 or iy - half < 0 or ix + half >= nx or iy + half >= ny:
        return None
    sl = np.s_[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
    d, v = np.asarray(img[sl], float), np.asarray(var[sl], float)
    mask = bad[sl] | ~np.isfinite(d) | ~np.isfinite(v) | (v <= 0)
    npar = (2 if fixed_xy else 4) + 2 * background_order
    if (~mask).sum() < npar + 3:
        return None

    def model(p: Any) -> Any:
        x, y, f, b = (x0, y0, *p[:2]) if fixed_xy else p[:4]
        result = f * epsf.stamp(iz, x - ix, y - iy, half) + b
        if background_order:
            yy, xx = np.mgrid[-half : half + 1, -half : half + 1]
            result = result + p[-2] * xx + p[-1] * yy
        return result

    def resid(p: Any) -> Any:
        return (d - model(p))[~mask] / np.sqrt(v[~mask])

    f0 = float(np.sum(d[~mask] - np.median(d[~mask])))
    p0 = [f0, float(np.median(d[~mask]))] if fixed_xy else [x0, y0, f0, float(np.median(d[~mask]))]
    if background_order:
        p0 += [0.0, 0.0]
    bounds = (
        (-np.inf, np.inf)
        if fixed_xy
        else ([x0 - max_shift, y0 - max_shift, -np.inf, -np.inf], [x0 + max_shift, y0 + max_shift, np.inf, np.inf])
    )
    if background_order and not fixed_xy:
        bounds = (list(bounds[0]) + [-np.inf, -np.inf], list(bounds[1]) + [np.inf, np.inf])
    r = least_squares(resid, p0, bounds=bounds, xtol=1e-11, ftol=1e-11, gtol=1e-11)
    if not r.success or (not fixed_xy and np.any(r.active_mask[:2])):
        return None
    _, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(r.jac, full_matrices=False)
    if s[-1] <= s[0] * 1e-10:
        return None
    dof = r.fun.size - npar
    chi = float(r.fun @ r.fun / dof)
    cov = ((vt.T / s**2) @ vt) * max(1.0, chi)
    return StarFit(r.x, cov, chi, dof, bool(mask[half - 1 : half + 2, half - 1 : half + 2].any()), model(r.x))


def fit_star(
    img: Any,
    var: Any,
    bad: Any,
    epsf: EPSF,
    iz: int,
    x0: float,
    y0: float,
    half: int = 3,
    fixed_xy: bool = False,
    max_shift: float = 1.5,
) -> Any:
    r = fit_native(img, var, bad, epsf, iz, x0, y0, half, fixed_xy, max_shift)
    return None if r is None else (r.params, r.errors, r.rchi2)


def fit_sources(img: Any, var: Any, bad: Any, epsf: EPSF, positions: Any, zones: Any, half: int = 4) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Simultaneous fixed-position signed amplitudes + sky, retaining blend covariance.

    Negative flux is valid for a non-detection. A nearly unresolved pair is rejected.
    """
    pos = np.asarray(positions, float)
    x0, y0 = np.mean(pos, axis=0)
    ix, iy = int(round(x0)), int(round(y0))
    if ix - half < 0 or iy - half < 0 or ix + half >= img.shape[1] or iy + half >= img.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError("blend stamp off image")
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
    sl = np.s_[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
    d, v = img[sl], var[sl]
    ok = ~bad[sl] & np.isfinite(d) & np.isfinite(v) & (v > 0)
    a = np.stack(
        [epsf.sample(z, xx - x, yy - y) for (x, y), z in zip(pos, zones, strict=True)] + [np.ones(d.shape)], axis=-1
    )
    from .astrometry import gls

    p, c, chi, dof = gls(a[ok], d[ok], np.diag(v[ok]))
    return dict(flux=p[:-1], covariance=c[:-1, :-1], background=p[-1], rchi2=chi / dof, dof=dof)


def fit_blend(
    img: Any,
    var: Any,
    bad: Any,
    epsf: EPSF,
    positions: Any,
    zones: Any,
    max_shift: float = 1.5,
    half: int = 4,
    shared_shift: bool = False,
) -> StarFit | None:
    """Joint signed flux covariance with a free centroid or shared WCS translation.

    shared_shift preserves catalogue separations and lets a bright neighbour constrain
    the local WCS translation even when the forced target flux is consistent with zero.
    The translation is a fitted nuisance parameter, never an exact registration.
    """
    pos = np.asarray(positions, float)
    ix, iy = np.rint(pos.mean(axis=0)).astype(int)
    if ix - half < 0 or iy - half < 0 or ix + half >= img.shape[1] or iy + half >= img.shape[0]:
        return None
    sl = np.s_[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
    d, v = img[sl], var[sl]
    ok = ~bad[sl] & np.isfinite(d) & np.isfinite(v) & (v > 0)
    npar = 3 + len(pos)
    if ok.sum() < npar + 3:
        return None
    try:
        seed = fit_sources(img, var, bad, epsf, pos, zones, half)
    except (ValueError, np.linalg.LinAlgError):
        return None

    def model(p: Any) -> Any:
        xy = pos + (p[:2] - pos[0]) if shared_shift else np.vstack([p[:2], pos[1:]])
        return sum(f * epsf.sample(z, xx - x, yy - y) for (x, y), f, z in zip(xy, p[2:-1], zones, strict=True)) + p[-1]

    p0 = np.r_[pos[0], seed["flux"], seed["background"]]
    lb = np.r_[pos[0] - max_shift, np.full(len(pos) + 1, -np.inf)]
    ub = np.r_[pos[0] + max_shift, np.full(len(pos) + 1, np.inf)]
    r = least_squares(lambda p: (d - model(p))[ok] / np.sqrt(v[ok]), p0, bounds=(lb, ub))
    _, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(r.jac, full_matrices=False)
    if not r.success or np.any(r.active_mask[:2]) or s[-1] <= s[0] * 1e-10:
        return None
    dof = len(r.fun) - npar
    chi = float(r.fun @ r.fun / dof)
    return StarFit(
        r.x,
        ((vt.T / s**2) @ vt) * max(1.0, chi),
        chi,
        dof,
        bool((~ok)[half - 1 : half + 2, half - 1 : half + 2].any()),
        model(r.x),
    )


@dataclass
class FittedPSF:
    """M→I display model preserving the native PSF orientation through its WCS."""

    epsf: EPSF
    zone_id: int
    wcs: Any
    x: float
    y: float
    flux: float

    def render(self, grid: Grid) -> Any:
        yy, xx = np.indices(grid.shape)
        nx, ny = self.wcs.world_to_pixel(grid.wcs.pixel_to_world(xx, yy))
        return self.flux * self.epsf.sample(self.zone_id, nx - self.x, ny - self.y)

backend/spherex/joint_astrometry.py.source:
"""Experimental joint native-pixel visit centroid, with registration nuisance terms.

Shared sky offset; independent nonnegative target/neighbour fluxes and free sky
per exposure. No coadd, interpolation of science images or fixed spectral shape.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.optimize import least_squares, nnls

from .epsf import EPSF


@dataclass
class JointFrame:
    image: Any
    variance: Any
    bad: Any
    epsf: EPSF
    positions: Any
    zones: tuple[int, int]
    sky_to_pixel: Any
    registration_error: Any


def prepare_frame(
    cf: Any, psf: EPSF, target: tuple[float, float], neighbour: tuple[float, float], registration: dict[str, Any]
) -> JointFrame:
    """Map sky offsets to this frame's native pixels; retain registration uncertainty."""
    from astropy import units as u
    from astropy.coordinates import SkyCoord

    offset = registration["offset"]

    def shifted(position: tuple[float, float]) -> Any:
        return SkyCoord(position[0] * u.deg, position[1] * u.deg).spherical_offsets_by(
            offset[0] * u.arcsec, offset[1] * u.arcsec
        )

    centre, other = shifted(target), shifted(neighbour)
    x, y = map(float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel(centre))
    nx, ny = map(float, cf.wcs.world_to_pixel(other))
    transform = np.empty((2, 2))
    for col, (dx, dy) in enumerate(((0.01, 0), (0, 0.01))):
        sky = centre.spherical_offsets_by(dx * u.arcsec, dy * u.arcsec)
        transform[:, col] = (np.asarray(cf.wcs.world_to_pixel(sky)) - [x, y]) / 0.01
    zones = psf.zone(x + cf.origin[0], y + cf.origin[1]), psf.zone(nx + cf.origin[0], ny + cf.origin[1])
    bad = cf.bad_phot | ((cf.flags & cf.bits.get("OVERFLOW", 0)) != 0)
    ix, iy = np.rint(np.mean([[x, y], [nx, ny]], axis=0)).astype(int)
    if ix < 4 or iy < 4 or ix + 4 >= cf.sci.shape[1] or iy + 4 >= cf.sci.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError("joint native stamp clipped")
    sl = np.s_[iy - 4 : iy + 5, ix - 4 : ix + 5]
    positions = np.array([[x, y], [nx, ny]]) - [ix - 4, iy - 4]
    return JointFrame(
        cf.sci[sl].copy(), cf.var[sl].copy(), bad[sl].copy(), psf, positions, zones, transform, registration["error"]
    )


def fit_visit(frames: list[JointFrame], max_shift_arcsec: float = 9.225) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Profile per-frame flux/sky; fit a shared centroid and uncertain translations.

    Nonnegative fluxes prevent an artificial positive/negative coincident-source
    cancellation. Registration shifts are Gaussian nuisances, not exact values.
    Returned Hessian covariance remains conditional on the PSF and likelihood.
    """
    if len(frames) < 2 or max_shift_arcsec <= 0:
        raise ValueError("at least two native frames and positive search bound required")
    prepared = []
    sizes = []
    for frame in frames:
        pos = np.asarray(frame.positions, float)
        transform = np.asarray(frame.sky_to_pixel, float)
        error = np.asarray(frame.registration_error, float)
        if pos.shape != (2, 2) or transform.shape != (2, 2) or error.shape != (2,) or np.any(error <= 0):
            raise ValueError("two positions, sky/pixel transform and positive registration errors required")
        if not all(np.all(np.isfinite(v)) for v in [pos, transform, error]):
            raise ValueError("finite geometry required")
        ix, iy = np.rint(pos.mean(axis=0)).astype(int)
        half = 4
        if ix - half < 0 or iy - half < 0 or ix + half >= frame.image.shape[1] or iy + half >= frame.image.shape[0]:
            raise ValueError("joint native stamp clipped")
        sl = np.s_[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
        yy, xx = np.mgrid[iy - half : iy + half + 1, ix - half : ix + half + 1]
        data, var = np.asarray(frame.image[sl], float), np.asarray(frame.variance[sl], float)
        ok = ~frame.bad[sl] & np.isfinite(data) & np.isfinite(var) & (var > 0)
        if ok.sum() < 8:
            raise ValueError("fewer than eight valid joint-stamp pixels")
        weight = 1 / np.sqrt(var[ok])
        background = weight / np.linalg.norm(weight)
        values = data[ok] * weight
        projected = values - background * (background @ values)
        prepared.append((frame, pos, transform, error, xx[ok], yy[ok], weight, background, values, projected))
        sizes.append(int(ok.sum()))

    n = len(frames)
    total = sum(sizes)
    pattern = sparse.lil_matrix((total + 2 * n, 2 + 2 * n), dtype=int)
    start = 0
    for j, size in enumerate(sizes):
        pattern[start : start + size, :2] = 1
        pattern[start : start + size, 2 + 2 * j : 4 + 2 * j] = 1
        pattern[total + 2 * j : total + 2 * j + 2, 2 + 2 * j : 4 + 2 * j] = 1
        start += size

    def residual(parameters: Any, return_flux: bool = False) -> Any:
        parts, fluxes = [], []
        for j, (frame, pos, transform, _error, xx, yy, weight, background, values, projected) in enumerate(prepared):
            translation = transform @ parameters[2 + 2 * j : 4 + 2 * j]
            target = pos[0] + translation + transform @ parameters[:2]
            neighbour = pos[1] + translation
            design = np.column_stack(
                [
                    frame.epsf.sample(z, xx - xy[0], yy - xy[1]) * weight
                    for xy, z in zip([target, neighbour], frame.zones, strict=True)
                ]
            )
            reduced = design - background[:, None] * (background @ design)
            flux, _ = nnls(reduced, projected)
            raw = values - design @ flux
            parts.append(raw - background * (background @ raw))
            fluxes.append(flux)
        for j, frame in enumerate(frames):
            parts.append(parameters[2 + 2 * j : 4 + 2 * j] / np.asarray(frame.registration_error))
        return fluxes if return_flux else np.concatenate(parts)

    lower, upper = np.full(2 + 2 * n, -np.inf), np.full(2 + 2 * n, np.inf)
    lower[:2], upper[:2] = -max_shift_arcsec, max_shift_arcsec
    alias = np.median([np.linalg.solve(v[2], v[1][1] - v[1][0]) for v in prepared], axis=0)
    solutions = []
    for start_offset in [np.zeros(2), 0.5 * alias, -0.5 * alias]:
        start = np.zeros(2 + 2 * n)
        start[:2] = np.clip(start_offset, -0.9 * max_shift_arcsec, 0.9 * max_shift_arcsec)
        candidate = least_squares(
            residual,
            start,
            bounds=(lower, upper),
            jac_sparsity=pattern.tocsr(),
            ftol=1e-9,
            xtol=1e-9,
            gtol=1e-9,
            max_nfev=300,
        )
        if candidate.success and not np.any(candidate.active_mask[:2]):
            solutions.append(candidate)
    if not solutions:
        raise ValueError("joint position is unconstrained or at search boundary")
    result = min(solutions, key=lambda p: p.cost)
    jac = result.jac.toarray()
    _, singular, right = np.linalg.svd(jac, full_matrices=False)
    if singular[-1] <= singular[0] * 1e-10:
        raise ValueError("rank-deficient joint centroid")
    dof = total - 3 * n - 2  # per-frame target/neighbor amplitudes and sky profiled out
    chi2 = float(result.fun @ result.fun)
    covariance = ((right.T / singular**2) @ right) * max(1.0, chi2 / dof)
    # A local Hessian cannot describe distinct competitive modes. Preserve a
    # failure instead of returning a narrow ellipse around just one mode.
    for candidate in solutions:
        delta = candidate.x[:2] - result.x[:2]
        if (
            2 * (candidate.cost - result.cost) <= 5.991464547
            and delta @ np.linalg.solve(covariance[:2, :2], delta) > 5.991464547
        ):
            raise ValueError("competitive separated joint-centroid modes; local covariance invalid")
    return dict(
        offset_arcsec=result.x[:2],
        covariance=covariance[:2, :2],
        chi2=chi2,
        dof=dof,
        registration_shifts=result.x[2:].reshape(n, 2),
        fluxes=np.asarray(residual(result.x, True)),
        n_frames=n,
        start_solutions=[dict(offset_arcsec=p.x[:2], chi2=float(p.fun @ p.fun)) for p in solutions],
        method="joint native pixel likelihood; nonnegative frame fluxes; Gaussian registration nuisances; conditional PSF/Hessian covariance",
    )

"""Catalogue resolution and common stellar position model (impl. ?4.1)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
import unicodedata
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

import numpy as np

from spherex.constants import TEST_TARGETS

from .astrometry import parallax_factors

ALIASES = {  # implementation.md §4.1 (what people type → an identifier SIMBAD resolves)
    "barnard's star": "NAME Barnard's Star",
    "barnards star": "NAME Barnard's Star",
    "barnard": "NAME Barnard's Star",
    "eps ind b": "* eps Ind B",
    "eps indi b": "* eps Ind B",
    "epsilon indi b": "* eps Ind B",
    "ε indi b": "* eps Ind B",
    "ε ind b": "* eps Ind B",
    "wise 0855": "WISE J085510.83-071442.5",
    "wise 0855-0714": "WISE J085510.83-071442.5",
    "wise j0855-0714": "WISE J085510.83-071442.5",
    "wise j085510.83-071442.5": "WISE J085510.83-071442.5",
    "rw aur": "V* RW Aur",
    "rw aurigae": "V* RW Aur",
    "r dra": "V* R Dra",
    "r draconis": "V* R Dra",
}
# SIMBAD identifier → TEST_TARGETS key (offline fallback) and the display name
OFFLINE = {
    "NAME Barnard's Star": ("Barnard's Star", "Barnard's Star", "BY*", "M4V"),
    "* eps Ind B": ("eps Ind B", "eps Ind B", "BD*", "T1+T6"),
    "WISE J085510.83-071442.5": ("WISE 0855-0714", "WISE 0855−0714", "BD*", "Y4"),
    "V* RW Aur": ("RW Aur", "RW Aur", "Or*", "K1/5"),
    "V* R Dra": ("R Dra", "R Dra", "Mi*", "M5e-M9e"),
}
BRIGHT_TARGETS = {"NAME Barnard's Star", "V* RW Aur", "V* R Dra"}  # `mask=auto` → bright preset (§4.3)


class ResolveError(LookupError):
    pass


class NeedsUpstream(RuntimeError):
    """The request needs a module another role owns (M's ephem.py for Solar System bodies)."""


def normalize_query(q: str) -> str:
    q = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", q)
    q = q.replace("−", "-").replace("–", "-").replace("’", "'").replace("′", "'").replace("″", '"')
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", q).strip()


_SEX = re.compile(
    r"^\s*(\d{1,2})[h: ]\s*(\d{1,2})[m: ]\s*(\d{1,2}(?:\.\d*)?)s?\s*[, ]?\s*"
    r"([+-]?)\s*(\d{1,2})[d°: ]\s*(\d{1,2})['m: ]\s*(\d{1,2}(?:\.\d*)?)\"?s?\s*$"
)
_DEC = re.compile(r"^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[, ]\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$")


def parse_coords(q: str) -> tuple[float, float] | None:
    """Decimal degrees ("269.4461 4.7707", "269.4461,4.7707") or sexagesimal ("08:55:10.831 -07:14:42.53",
    "08h55m10.831s -07d14m42.53s"), Unicode minus allowed. Returns (ra, dec) in degrees, or None."""
    s = normalize_query(q)
    m = _DEC.match(s)
    if m:
        ra, dec = float(m[1]), float(m[2])
    else:
        m = _SEX.match(s)
        if not m:
            return None
        if int(m[2]) >= 60 or float(m[3]) >= 60 or int(m[6]) >= 60 or float(m[7]) >= 60:
            raise ResolveError("sexagesimal minutes and seconds must be below 60")
        ra = 15.0 * (int(m[1]) + int(m[2]) / 60 + float(m[3]) / 3600)
        dec = (int(m[5]) + int(m[6]) / 60 + float(m[7]) / 3600) * (-1 if m[4] == "-" else 1)
    if not (0.0 <= ra < 360.0 and -90.0 <= dec <= 90.0):
        raise ResolveError(f"coordinates out of range: RA {ra}, Dec {dec}")
    return ra, dec


def parse_coord_pair(ra: str, dec: str) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """URL form ra=08:55:10.831&dec=-07:14:42.53 or decimal degrees."""
    r = parse_coords(f"{ra} {dec}")
    if r is None:
        raise ResolveError(f"cannot read coordinates ra={ra!r} dec={dec!r}")
    return r


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- astrometry (§4.1)


def _time(mjd: Any) -> Any:
    from astropy.time import Time

    return Time(np.asarray(mjd, float), format="mjd")


@dataclass
class Target:
    """A resolved source with everything pos(t) needs. epoch: decimal Julian year of (ra, dec)."""

    query: str
    kind: str  # star | coords | sso
    name: str
    ra: float
    dec: float
    epoch: float = 2016.0
    pmra: float | None = None  # mas/yr (pmra* = μα cos δ)
    pmdec: float | None = None
    plx: float | None = None  # mas
    rv: float | None = None  # km/s, only with Gaia's own epoch
    main_id: str | None = None
    otype: str | None = None
    spt: str | None = None
    astrometry_source: str | None = None
    extra: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def moving(self) -> bool:
        return self.kind == "sso" or (self.kind == "star" and bool(self.pmra or self.pmdec or self.plx))

    def pos(self, mjd: Any) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
        """pos(t) as seen by SPHEREx (implementation.md §4.1). Arrays in, arrays out (deg)."""
        mjd = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(mjd, float))
        if self.kind == "sso":
            from .ephem import cached_position

            return cached_position(self.extra.get("ephemeris", {}), mjd)
        if not self.moving:
            return np.full(mjd.shape, self.ra), np.full(mjd.shape, self.dec)
        return seen_by_spherex(self, mjd)


def propagate(
    ra: float,
    dec: float,
    pmra_masyr: float | None,
    pmdec_masyr: float | None,
    plx_mas: float | None,
    rv_kms: float | None,
    epoch_from: Any,
    epoch_to: Any,
) -> Any:
    import astropy.units as u
    from astropy.coordinates import Distance, SkyCoord

    kw: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if plx_mas is not None and plx_mas > 0:
        kw["distance"] = Distance(parallax=plx_mas * u.mas)
        if rv_kms is not None:
            kw["radial_velocity"] = rv_kms * u.km / u.s
    c = SkyCoord(
        ra=ra * u.deg,
        dec=dec * u.deg,
        pm_ra_cosdec=(pmra_masyr or 0) * u.mas / u.yr,
        pm_dec=(pmdec_masyr or 0) * u.mas / u.yr,
        obstime=epoch_from,
        **kw,
    )
    return c.apply_space_motion(new_obstime=epoch_to)


def seen_by_spherex(src: Target, mjd: Any, sc_geo_km: Any = None) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
    import astropy.units as u
    from astropy.coordinates import SkyCoord
    from astropy.time import Time

    c = propagate(src.ra, src.dec, src.pmra, src.pmdec, src.plx, src.rv, Time(src.epoch, format="jyear"), _time(mjd))
    pa, pd = parallax_factors(mjd, c.ra.deg, c.dec.deg, sc_geo_km)
    # Spherical offset avoids division by cos(dec) at the poles, wraps RA correctly.
    p = max(src.plx or 0.0, 0.0) / 1000.0
    shifted = SkyCoord(c.ra, c.dec).spherical_offsets_by(p * pa * u.arcsec, p * pd * u.arcsec)
    return shifted.ra.deg, shifted.dec.deg


def mjd_now() -> float:
    from astropy.time import Time

    return float(Time.now().mjd)


def decimal_year(mjd: float) -> float:
    return float(_time(mjd).jyear)


def sep_arcsec(ra1: float, dec1: float, ra2: float, dec2: float) -> float:
    r1, d1, r2, d2 = map(math.radians, (ra1, dec1, ra2, dec2))
    c = math.sin(d1) * math.sin(d2) + math.cos(d1) * math.cos(d2) * math.cos(r1 - r2)
    return math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, c)))) * 3600


def pa_deg(ra1: float, dec1: float, ra2: float, dec2: float) -> float:
    r1, d1, r2, d2 = map(math.radians, (ra1, dec1, ra2, dec2))
    y = math.sin(r2 - r1) * math.cos(d2)
    x = math.cos(d1) * math.sin(d2) - math.sin(d1) * math.cos(d2) * math.cos(r2 - r1)
    return math.degrees(math.atan2(y, x)) % 360


def compass(pa: float) -> str:
    names = ["north", "north-east", "east", "south-east", "south", "south-west", "west", "north-west"]
    return names[int(((pa + 22.5) % 360) // 45)]


def epoch_of_match(ra_in: float, dec_in: float, t: Target) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """implementation.md §4.1: the decimal year at which t's track passes closest to the input."""
    years = np.arange(1990.0, 2031.0, 0.02)
    from astropy.time import Time

    mjd = Time(years, format="jyear").mjd
    track = propagate(t.ra, t.dec, t.pmra, t.pmdec, t.plx, None, Time(t.epoch, format="jyear"), Time(mjd, format="mjd"))
    ra, dec = track.ra.deg, track.dec.deg
    seps = np.array([sep_arcsec(ra_in, dec_in, a, b) for a, b in zip(ra, dec, strict=True)])
    i = int(np.argmin(seps))
    return float(years[i]), float(seps[i])


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ resolver


def offline_target(ident: str, query: str) -> Target | None:
    if ident not in OFFLINE:
        return None
    key, name, otype, spt = OFFLINE[ident]
    ra, dec, ep, pmra, pmdec, plx, rv, src = TEST_TARGETS[key]
    return Target(
        query=query,
        kind="star",
        name=name,
        ra=ra,
        dec=dec,
        epoch=ep,
        pmra=pmra,
        pmdec=pmdec,
        plx=plx,
        rv=rv,
        main_id=ident,
        otype=otype,
        spt=spt,
        astrometry_source=f"{src} (offline table)",
    )


async def resolve_name(query: str, client: Any | None) -> Target:
    """Name → Target. client=None means offline: only the acceptance targets resolve."""
    q = normalize_query(query)
    if q.lower().startswith("sso:"):
        return await resolve_sso(q[4:], client)
    ident = ALIASES.get(q.lower(), q)
    if client is None:
        t = offline_target(ident, query)
        if t is None:
            raise ResolveError(
                f'"{query}" is not in the offline target table. Try RA/Dec, or one of: '
                "Barnard's Star, eps Ind B, WISE 0855-0714, RW Aur, R Dra."
            )
        return t
    from spherex.external.gaia import GaiaClient
    from spherex.external.simbad import SimbadClient

    sim = SimbadClient(client)
    try:
        o = await sim.by_identifier(ident)
    except Exception as e:  # SIMBAD down: degrade to the offline table
        t = offline_target(ident, query)
        if t is None:
            raise ResolveError(
                f"SIMBAD is unreachable ({type(e).__name__}) and {query!r} is not an offline target"
            ) from e
        t.extra["warning"] = "SIMBAD unreachable: catalogue values from the offline table"
        return t
    if o is None or o.ra is None or o.dec is None:
        return await resolve_sso(query, client)
    t = Target(
        query=query,
        kind="star",
        name=o.main_id,
        ra=o.ra,
        dec=o.dec,
        epoch=2000.0,
        pmra=o.pmra,
        pmdec=o.pmdec,
        plx=o.plx,
        rv=None,
        main_id=o.main_id,
        otype=o.otype,
        spt=o.sp_type,
        astrometry_source="SIMBAD J2000 (linear)",
    )
    try:
        gid = await sim.gaia_dr3_id(o.oid)
        if gid is not None:
            g = await GaiaClient(client).by_id([gid])
            if g and g[0].pmra is not None:
                s = g[0]
                t = Target(
                    query=query,
                    kind="star",
                    name=o.main_id,
                    ra=s.ra,
                    dec=s.dec,
                    epoch=2016.0,
                    pmra=s.pmra,
                    pmdec=s.pmdec,
                    plx=s.parallax,
                    rv=s.radial_velocity,
                    main_id=o.main_id,
                    otype=o.otype,
                    spt=o.sp_type,
                    astrometry_source=f"Gaia DR3 {gid}",
                )
    except Exception:  # Gaia down: SIMBAD values stand (labelled)
        pass
    if ident == "V* RW Aur":
        b = await GaiaClient(client).by_id([156430822114424576])
        if not b:
            raise ResolveError("RW Aur needs Gaia B kinematics; Hipparcos/A RUWE=16 cannot be used")
        t.pmra, t.pmdec, t.plx, t.rv = b[0].pmra, b[0].pmdec, b[0].parallax, None
        t.astrometry_source = "Gaia DR3 A position; B PM/parallax (A RUWE=16)"
    return t


async def epoch_guard(
    ra: float, dec: float, client: Any | None
) -> tuple[Target | None, dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
    """Typed coordinates: is this a high-PM object at another epoch (P0-1)? Returns (object, hint, label)."""
    cands: list[Target] = []
    if client is not None:
        try:
            from spherex.external.simbad import SimbadClient

            for o in await SimbadClient(client).high_pm_cone(ra, dec, 0.1):
                if o.ra is not None and o.dec is not None:
                    cands.append(
                        Target(
                            query="",
                            kind="star",
                            name=o.main_id,
                            ra=o.ra,
                            dec=o.dec,
                            epoch=2000.0,
                            pmra=o.pmra,
                            pmdec=o.pmdec,
                            plx=o.plx,
                            main_id=o.main_id,
                            otype=o.otype,
                            spt=o.sp_type,
                            astrometry_source="SIMBAD J2000 (linear)",
                        )
                    )
        except Exception:
            cands = []
    if not cands:
        for ident in OFFLINE:
            t = offline_target(ident, "")
            if t is not None and sep_arcsec(ra, dec, t.ra, t.dec) < 0.1 * 3600 * 3:  # cheap prefilter (18′)
                cands.append(t)
    now = mjd_now()
    best: tuple[Target, float, float] | None = None
    for t in cands:
        yr, sep = epoch_of_match(ra, dec, t)
        if sep < 3.0 and (best is None or sep < best[2]):
            best = (t, yr, sep)
    if best is None:
        return None, None, None
    t, yr, sep = best
    nra, ndec = (float(v[0]) for v in t.pos([now]))
    if abs(yr - decimal_year(now)) <= 1.0:
        return t, None, f"{t.name} ({int(decimal_year(now))} position)"
    pa = pa_deg(ra, dec, nra, ndec)
    hint = dict(
        object=t.name,
        epoch=round(yr, 2),
        sep_arcsec=round(sep, 2),
        now_ra=nra,
        now_dec=ndec,
        moved_arcmin=round(sep_arcsec(ra, dec, nra, ndec) / 60, 2),
        direction=compass(pa),
    )
    return t, hint, None


def coords_target(query: str, ra: float, dec: float) -> Target:
    return Target(
        query=query, kind="coords", name=f"{ra:.5f} {dec:+.5f}", ra=ra, dec=dec, epoch=decimal_year(mjd_now())
    )


def to_result(t: Target, hint: dict[str, Any] | None = None, label: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    now = mjd_now()
    if t.kind == "sso":
        nra, ndec = t.ra, t.dec
        now = float(_time(now).mjd)
    else:
        nra, ndec = (float(v[0]) for v in t.pos([now]))
    return dict(
        query=t.query,
        kind=t.kind,
        name=t.name,
        main_id=t.main_id,
        ra=t.ra,
        dec=t.dec,
        epoch=t.epoch,
        pm=(t.pmra, t.pmdec) if t.pmra is not None and t.pmdec is not None else None,
        plx=t.plx,
        rv=t.rv,
        otype=t.otype,
        spt=t.spt,
        astrometry_source=t.astrometry_source,
        propagated_now=dict(ra=nra, dec=ndec, epoch=round(decimal_year(now), 3)),
        epoch_hint=hint,
        label_hint=label,
    )


async def resolve_sso(name: str, client: Any) -> Target:
    if client is None:
        raise NeedsUpstream("Horizons ephemerides require a recorded or live Horizons client")
    from .external.horizons import positions

    mjd = mjd_now()
    rows = await positions(client, name, [mjd])
    return Target(
        query="sso:" + name,
        kind="sso",
        name=name,
        ra=rows[0][0],
        dec=rows[0][1],
        epoch=decimal_year(mjd),
        extra={"ephemeris": {str(mjd): rows[0]}, "command": name},
    )
